name: Bloodlines
source: Bloodlines follows a female lead named Angelica as she establishes a new life in a new city. This is a crime drama that follows Angelica as she navigates life as a new private investigator.
translation: Bloodlines follows a female lead named Angelica as she establishes a new life in a new city. This is a crime drama that follows Angelica as she navigates life as a new private investigator.
